composer-2-fast.concept: Triage sentence cards onto two belts — human line vs model line — before they lock into tomorrow's page.
composer-2-fast.mechanic: Sort and lane-switch cards under a ticking deadline.
composer-2-fast.touch_control: Drag each card left or right to a conveyor.
composer-2-fast.session_hook: Forty-five seconds of red-pencil panic that still feels fair.
composer-2-fast.escalation: Cards sprout footnotes, strikethroughs, and urgent pings.
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: Newsprint, margin notes, soft desk lamp

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flick droplets into a cloud that must stay balanced while spring wind tries to shear it apart.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: Physics flick to attach vapor without tipping the whole mass.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: Flick from the stack toward the cloud body.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Watching the cloud grow and wobble stays hypnotic.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Gusts tilt the sky and add spinning debris.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: High pastel blues, thin contrails, glassy highlights

kimi-k2.6.concept: Draw one continuous path through a grid of locks and loans without touching a live borrow twice.
kimi-k2.6.mechanic: Path drawing with instant failure on illegal reuse.
kimi-k2.6.touch_control: Drag a line from start to exit.
kimi-k2.6.session_hook: A clean route reads like a tiny proof.
kimi-k2.6.escalation: Nested scopes add mirrored dead ends and trap tiles.
kimi-k2.6.aesthetic: Monospace on faint graph paper, ink that fades behind you

composer-matterhorn-training.concept: Keep a glass bulb in the green band as a spring day throws heat spikes and night chill at you.
composer-matterhorn-training.mechanic: Hold to bank warmth, release to shed it before overshoot.
composer-matterhorn-training.touch_control: Hold and release on the bulb.
composer-matterhorn-training.session_hook: Sixty seconds of breathing with the thermometer.
composer-matterhorn-training.escalation: The safe band narrows and jitters with fake forecasts.
composer-matterhorn-training.aesthetic: Minimal weather-app chrome, SF spring palette

google-gemma-4-31b-it.concept: Switch bike lanes along a waterfront as sunset stretches silhouettes and gaps shrink.
google-gemma-4-31b-it.mechanic: Lane switch to slip between obstacles and shadow lines.
google-gemma-4-31b-it.touch_control: Swipe left or right to change lanes.
google-gemma-4-31b-it.session_hook: Near misses feel sharp without punishing thumbs.
google-gemma-4-31b-it.escalation: Tourist clumps and cable-car gaps tighten the rhythm.
google-gemma-4-31b-it.aesthetic: Long shadows, warm concrete, low golden sun

claude-nougat-eap-thinking-max.concept: Peel evening fog off a single window to reveal one tree; each round gives fewer peels before it resets.
claude-nougat-eap-thinking-max.mechanic: One-screen puzzle — clear panels in the right order.
claude-nougat-eap-thinking-max.touch_control: Swipe across a fog panel to peel it.
claude-nougat-eap-thinking-max.session_hook: The full reveal lands in one satisfying gesture.
claude-nougat-eap-thinking-max.escalation: Fog regrows faster between peels and hides edges.
claude-nougat-eap-thinking-max.aesthetic: Charcoal mist, one sharp green canopy
